list: The official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation Network, 18 November 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 27 visible, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them, cross-checked against each other.
notes: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. Source: Output Lag, GTA 6 Trophy List.

Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because one meditation spot (Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1) disappears after that chapter. Source: PowerPyx and GTABase, reported by Output Lag, KeenGamer and EGamers.
Cheats disable trophies, and saving stops once one is used. Leave cheats off for a trophy run. Source: PowerPyx, reported by Planet GTA 6.
No trophy needs online play. All 55 unlock in single-player. Source: Planet GTA 6, KeenGamer.
The platinum takes around 200 hours. Source: Output Lag.

roadmap.title: Before you start: saves and cheats
roadmap.text: Turn cheats off — they disable trophies and stop saving. Then make a habit that carries the whole run: a manual save at the start of every chapter and one more before the final mission. The game has no mission replay, so those saves are your only way back to anything you miss.

roadmap.title: Play the story, chapters 1 to 4
roadmap.text: Play straight through. The opening mission, the four chapters and the big story missions each pop a trophy when they end, and every one of them is hidden on PlayStation until you earn it, so the spoiler setting in this guide hides them too. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 the first time you can — it is the one spot that disappears later.

roadmap.title: Character strands and strangers
roadmap.text: After the story opens up, finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each strand ends with a trophy — plus Bret's hunt and eight stranger strands across Leonida. These are the silver Strangers & Freaks and the five hidden strand finales.

roadmap.title: Meditation and collectibles
roadmap.text: Clear the collectible sets while you still roam freely: all 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, every region of Leonida explored and every garage bought. Meditation comes first in this stage because it holds the run's only reported missable.

roadmap.title: Activities, robberies and money
roadmap.text: The long grind: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 20 different races, a Top Fun drone race at every location, 50 challenges, and the robbery set — 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected, one illegal operation per gang — plus $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. Do the partner robberies while your partner is still around.

roadmap.title: The ending, 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: Finish the final mission — the second gold — then check the in-game 100% checklist. Its 35 tasks are mostly the trophies above, so A Long Road should pop as the last of them, and the platinum follows at once.

roadmap.title: The cryptic ones
roadmap.text: Eight hidden trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch — the cocktail on Ocean Beach, the showroom smash, the bowling alley, the partnership, the choices, the second try, the strange event and the melee drive-by. Their descriptions are the only clues, so try the literal reading of each one and check a fresh guide before grinding any of them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for the other 54, so there is no shortcut: finish the story, clear the character strands, then work through the collectibles, activities and robberies until the last one pops. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order and it doubles as the platinum checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It pops the moment the mission ends, so just play the story from the start — no preparation needed.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Before you start the chapter, make a manual save: the game has no mission replay, so a save at the chapter start is your only way back. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony the first time you can — that spot disappears after the chapter and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay; the missable meditation spot)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep the habit from Chapter 1: a manual save at the chapter start, since there is no mission replay. Both protagonists become playable around here, which opens up most of the side list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Same routine: a manual save at the chapter start, then play through to the chapter's end and the trophy pops.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. One more manual save at the chapter start, then play it through — this is the last numbered chapter before the finale.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the story's ending and the second gold trophy. Save before it: with no mission replay and no New Game Plus, that manual save is the only way to replay the ending or see a different outcome.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay, no New Game Plus)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, like every story mission trophy — just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A big story heist, so expect a longer mission — the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name gives the place away — an airport takedown — and the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy: play it through and it pops at the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist. The checklist has 35 tasks, and most of them are the visible trophies themselves — the collectible sets, the activities, the robberies and exploring Leonida — so this pops near the very end, just before the platinum. Open the checklist in-game and clear whatever it still shows.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements (the 35-task 100% checklist)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses and long air time all count. They add up over normal play, so do not grind them early; check the in-game stunt count once the map is open and mop up the last ones with repeated jumps.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game counts the activity types it offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest — so sample one of everything as you meet it instead of leaving them all to the end.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold each challenge as you unlock it; the range tracks medals per challenge, so you can see exactly which ones still need gold. Slow, aimed shots beat spraying.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Learn one location's course, win it, then move to the next — the trophy counts locations won, not total wins, so repeating a course you already won adds nothing.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: winning the same race twice counts once, so work through the race list and tick off new ones instead of farming your favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the fishing challenge against Cal when it appears and out-fish him — steady reeling and clean landings beat rushing, and the challenge is about the catch, not the fight.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start any game on it and play it through to the end — finishing is what counts, not the score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; take every one you meet and follow each strand to its end — eight completed strands is the count, not eight single missions.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. This is the one trophy reported as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate at the balcony the first time you can, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and clear the remaining spots before the story moves on.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (18 meditation spots)
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (the missable spot; no mission replay)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal he names and bring it down — a unique animal, so it is one specific target rather than any animal you happen to meet.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, so three full sets is the goal, not just three cards. Keep a set checklist as you pick cards up.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at landmarks and viewpoints across the map and use it there — each new location counts once, so keep moving to places you have not used it at yet.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; they stack up across everything you do, so this pops during normal completionist play. Check the challenge list to see which kinds you still have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears — both of you have to make it out, so do not split up mid-escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside and keep the heat on the whole run — losing the wanted level between shops breaks the chain, so plan a short route between the three shops first.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything new you see — the game logs each vehicle type the first time you get in it, so variety matters more than mileage. Try car parks, docks and back roads for the rarer ones.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five, trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends — a crowded fight is the place to try it, not a duel. Save first so you can retry the same fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description is the only clue and the method is still unconfirmed at launch, so treat any walkthrough that claims a fixed route with care and check a fresh guide before grinding it.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (unconfirmed methods at launch)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the description points at the Rhino tank. Get into one and use it; the exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, so the description itself is the plan until a guide confirms more.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (unconfirmed methods at launch)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — being spotted at any point voids it, so scout the store first and save before you go in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape — plan the getaway before you go in, and count the vaults you have already cleared so you do not repeat one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take the cash and get away clean — the escape is part of the trophy, so do not linger at the scene.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The game tracks which regions you have visited, so sweep the corners, the Keys and the back roads, not just the cities — fly or drive the map edges until every region registers.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations; hit one per gang, so you need to find each gang's operation rather than robbing the same gang twice.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view and order a cocktail. There is no confirmed method at launch — the description itself is the guide, so try the literal reading first.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a showroom and out through the frontage — the method is unconfirmed at launch, so use the description as the plan and check a fresh guide if it does not pop.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl at that alley and follow through on the shot — the exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, so the description is the plan.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description hints at a partner activity that draws a crowd; there is no confirmed method at launch, so do not grind blindly — wait for a guide to pin the trigger down.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A story-choice trophy — it pops when a decision lands. Keep a manual save before big decisions, since there is no mission replay to go back and choose differently.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name suggests failing something once and landing it on the second try; there is no confirmed method at launch, so treat this as a retry trophy and check a fresh guide before chasing it.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The name and description point at a strange, probably random encounter somewhere in Leonida; there is no confirmed method at launch, so do not grind for it — it will most likely find you while you explore.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The literal reading is a drive-by with a melee weapon near the bowling alley — the exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, so try that reading and check a fresh guide if it does not pop.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no confirmed unlock method at launch)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to launder them and the total builds toward $250,000. Rob first, launder after — the bills only count once they are clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend it anywhere — clothes, food, gear — the total across all shops is what counts, so it builds on its own if you shop as you play. Save it for the endgame and buy the expensive things then.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; the property list shows which ones you still need, so work through it and keep enough cash aside for the last ones.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles through it — each new registration counts, so use ten different vehicles rather than the same one ten times.
